title: Abandoning Objectives: Evolution Through the Search for Novelty Alone
author: Joel Lehman, Kenneth O. Stanley
summary: Argues that searching for behavioral novelty (rather than optimizing an objective) can outperform conventional objective-based evolutionary methods on tasks like maze navigation and biped walking. Foundational novelty-search paper. Abstract elided by publisher; available verbatim only via DOI access.
quotes_from_metadata: objective functions themselves may actively misdirect search toward dead ends
some problems are best solved by methods that ignore the objective
